data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Andros, meaning 'man' or 'manly'. In the Bible, Andrew is the brother of Simon Peter and the first disciple called by Jesus. The name Andrel carries the meaning “Man of man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andrel usually hope their child will grow to embody man of man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Andrel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of man.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Andrel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Andrel or Andrew was popular in the early Christian era and was common amongst the early Christians communities in Europe and the Middle East. The name gained popularity due to the early Christian saint and apostle Andrew, who was a significant figure in Christianity and was one of the twelve apostles that Jesus chose to spread his teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the apostle Andrew is considered a symbol of brotherhood and discipleship. He is revered as a patron saint of fishermen, fisheries, and singers. The spiritual significance of the name Andrel or Andrew is rooted in its biblical origins, and it serves as a reminder of the call to follow Jesus and live a faithful Christian life.
